'''Jaymizu Poh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Tarisian who lived on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], she and her brother [[Relus Poh]] were trying to reclaim land on Taris that belonged to their family, but the area was patrolled by hostile defense droids owned by a group of [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] who were living in the estate as refugees.<ref name="TOR" />
